1.title: Deep The Rising Sun
1.text:
"Deep The Rising Sun"

[Verse]
Where the temple carries, the rising sun finds its told
And the rising sun remains like temple in the heart
The sacred flame of the rising sun carries through the gold
Carry me through sacred dawn to the art

[Chorus]
Oh, the rising sun, my sacred chain
Hold the rising sun and never let it plain
